hypothesis_title: DPL-RC v1.0 — 1715 약세 상태에서만 기대수익/방어력이 올라가는 conditional complement sleeve를 학습 (1715 대체 X, 보완)
hypothesis_description: STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2 (admit SR 1.9536, gap 0.0464 = 97.9% milestone closure) production lineage 보존 + DPL-RC complement sleeve 학습 + small injection (a_max 5~20%) overlay. 핵심 paradigm: (1) **bad month subset 학습 X — full sample (124 sig_dates) + bad-state conditional loss weighting** (statistical learning 본질 정합, 코덱스 핵심 수정). (2) p_bad_1715(t+1) classifier 사전 OOS validation gate (AUC≥0.55 + Brier<0.24 + recall≥0.60) 통과 의무 — fail 시 ABORT (사후 regime fitting 차단). (3) Complement scorer incremental (linear → elastic-net → LightGBM → DPL-RC Neural) — 4단계 mini-forge feasibility 정합. (4) Injection grid 5/10/15/20% Pareto admission curve. (5) 1715 alpha core retain — w_final(t) = (1-a_t)·w_1715(t) + a_t·w_comp(t), a_t = clip(a_max · p_bad_1715(t), 0, a_max). 학술 backbone: Ferson-Schadt 1996 (Conditional Alpha) + Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 (BAB crisis hedge) + Brandt-Santa-Clara-Valkanov 2009 (Parametric Portfolio Policy linear baseline) + Wood-Roberts-Zohren 2026 (DeePM regime-conditional EVaR) + Avramov-Cheng-Metzker 2023 RFS (ML conditional return prediction with regime states). 도훈 mandate '1715 보완 방향' + 코덱스 의견 100% ACCEPT.
